name: flash-keep-awake
description: For flash storage (iFlash and similar adapters). The iPod keeps the storage on for 30 minutes after each use, not for 1 second. When the iPod wakes from sleep, it starts the storage at once, so that the storage is ready when you choose a song. When the iPod goes to sleep, it switches the storage off as usual.
hdd_warning: This patch is for flash storage. On the original hard drive, it keeps the disk turning for 30 minutes after each use. This uses more battery and causes more wear.
